labels.io.gravitee.description: Sets up the playground with its own Dockerfile
labels.io.gravitee.name: Playground seed

files.compose.yml:
x-gravitee: {kind: playground, name: Seeder with its own Dockerfile, category: Other, description: Builds the seeder's folder with a Dockerfile of its own}
services:
  hostile-n01-dockerfile-seed:
    image: hostile-seeder
    build:
      context: ../../../../../seeder
      dockerfile: ../.lab/catalogs/hostile/playgrounds/n01-seeder-own-dockerfile/Dockerfile
    pull_policy: build
    restart: "no"
    labels:
      io.gravitee.role: seed
      io.gravitee.name: Playground seed
      io.gravitee.description: Sets up the playground with its own Dockerfile
    volumes:
      - ./seed:/seed:ro
    environment:
      APIM_MANAGEMENT_URL: http://apim-management-api:8083
      APIM_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8082
      HOSTILE_DEMO_PASSWORD: ${HOSTILE_DEMO_PASSWORD:-demo}

meta.description: Builds the seeder's folder with a Dockerfile of its own
meta.name: Seeder with its own Dockerfile
